summary: verdaccio-okta-oauth preinstall downloads Bun runtime to execute bundled obfuscated payload
details: The package declares a preinstall hook ("node setup.mjs") that downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases into a temporary directory, chmods it executable, and invokes it against math_init.js — a 727KB single-line, string-array-shuffled, hex-identifier Bun-compiled artifact (@bun @bun-cjs header) shipped inside the package. The advertised purpose is a Verdaccio Okta OAuth plugin, which has no relationship to the Bun runtime; the alternate runtime is used solely to execute the bundled obfuscated blob on the installer's host during npm install. Because the executed code is the shipped opaque payload (not Bun's own source), the publisher-legitimacy of the Bun release URL does not make the execution benign — the harm is the auto-execution of unreviewable code at install time under a non-Node interpreter that Node-based static analysis cannot introspect.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
